FIELDS.NAME: Playful Pals Toy Store
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At Playful Pals Toy Store, we specialize in providing a wide variety of high-quality toys for children of all ages. Our core operations include the retail sale of educational, imaginative, and engaging toys in a friendly and welcoming environment. We ensure rigorous compliance with all relevant safety regulations, including those set forth by the Consumer Product Safety Commission (CPSC), to guarantee that our products are safe for children. Additionally, we implement comprehensive inventory controls, regular stock audits, and maintain detailed documentation to manage our supplies effectively and minimize losses. Our employees receive ongoing training in product handling and customer service to ensure the highest quality of assistance to our customers. We prioritize customer feedback and have established clear policies for addressing any concerns promptly, fostering a trustworthy relationship with our community. With our commitment to safety and customer satisfaction, we aim to be the premier destination for toy shopping in Toytown.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Loss dates: 05/02/2023; Cause: Water damage from a broken pipe; Amount: $2,000; Status: Resolved. Loss dates: 09/15/2023; Cause: Employee slip and fall due to misplaced merchandise; Amount: $3,000; Status: Pending resolution.
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Standard Retail Safe, Class B, UL-rated
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Local security personnel for store monitoring and theft prevention.
FIELDS.G1: Do/have past, present or discontinue: No – Playful Pals Toy Store does not engage in storing, treating, discharging, applying, disposing, or transporting hazardous materials. Our operations focus solely on the retail of toys, ensuring compliance with safety regulations.
FIELDS.G2: Are athletic teams sponsored?: Yes – Playful Pals Toy Store sponsors local youth athletic teams to foster community engagement and support children's activities.
FIELDS.G3: Are sub-contractors allowed to work: No – Sub-contractors are not allowed to work without providing a certificate of insurance. The store manager, Jessica Thompson, is responsible for checking the certificates.
FIELDS.G4: Has any applicant been indicted or c: No – There have been no indictments or convictions related to fraud, bribery, arson, or any other arson-related crimes connected to this or any other property. The applicant maintains a clean legal and operational history.
FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: No – Playful Pals Toy Store has not had any policy or coverage declined, canceled, or non-renewed during the prior three years. We have maintained consistent insurance coverage without any interruptions.
FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – Playful Pals Toy Store does not lease employees to or from other employers, as our staffing is managed internally to maintain control over operations and service quality.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: Yes – Playful Pals Toy Store has obtained Workers' Compensation coverage to ensure compliance with legal requirements and protect our employees in the event of work-related injuries.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: No – Playful Pals Toy Store does not own or operate any other business. Our focus is solely on providing a wide variety of high-quality toys for children within our retail store.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – Playful Pals Toy Store does not have any other insurance policies with this company at this time. The only current policy is the primary one, which is PP-2023-001.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – Playful Pals Toy Store is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products; our operations focus solely on the retail of a wide variety of toys.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – Playful Pals Toy Store does not rent or loan equipment to others, as our operations focus solely on the retail of toys without any equipment rental services.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – Playful Pals Toy Store has not had any foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien during the past five years. The business maintains a positive financial standing and operates without any financial distress.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – Playful Pals Toy Store does not have any exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals, as our operations focus solely on the retail sale of toys, ensuring a safe environment for our customers.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – Playful Pals Toy Store does not have any catastrophe exposure as our operations are solely focused on retailing toys and comply with safety regulations, minimizing risk.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – Playful Pals Toy Store has no past losses or claims relating to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. The store maintains a focus on safety and compliance in all operations.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – Playful Pals Toy Store has no uncorrected fire code violations and maintains compliance with fire safety regulations.

The store is well-organized and easy to navigate. I found exactly what I was looking for without any hassle!
